title: Guided Brand Brain Setup & Review Control

notes: Normal Brand setup is lightweight and suggestion-led while the full editor remains under Advanced Brand Brain / Review & Control.
Owner goals and explicit hard directives are authoritative confirmed context; generated strategy remains source-backed inferred context until confirmed.
Confirmed fields cannot be silently overwritten by guided inference.
Public reference retrieval is bounded, DNS-validated, address-pinned and redirect-revalidated; public text is untrusted source material, never instructions.
Generated fields require field-level provenance from inspected Brand references.
No database migration, infrastructure, release, deployment, VS-23 or VS-24 activation is authorized.

approvals.rationale: The owner approved the proposed VS-26 Guided Brand Brain Setup & Review Control scope after reviewing the reduced-input approach and explicitly said Good to go.

FR-02/03/04, the approved Brand isolation architecture and DEC-006 already govern inferred-vs-confirmed context, provenance and source removal. The slice does not expand cross-Brand or publishing authority.
The owner's Good to go instruction authorizes bounded runtime implementation of the agreed guided setup and Advanced Review & Control experience.
Exact certification-candidate gates are running; explicit human approval remains required.

evidence: RED TDD established owner authority, source provenance, confirmed-field non-overwrite, safe degradation, SSRF-safe public reference retrieval and zero-tool strategist proposal contracts before runtime implementation.

CI #583 exposed an invalid Next.js server-action re-export only at production web build after earlier deterministic tests/typechecks had passed; the implementation was repaired with explicit async server-action wrappers without weakening any gate.

Verified implementation head b227ee2d68f830fa92deed201be28042142f48b7 passed CI #589, Security baseline #528 and Product Intake #453, including clean PostgreSQL 18 migrations, dependency audit, preflight, full runtime verification and production web build.
Formal testing-transition head 908d5162903efc6b5a9906b6e60e768db45975f4 passed CI #590, Security baseline #529 and Product Intake #454.
